title: Accounting and Tax Services for Dance Schools

rows.before: On one growing school we shifted $40,000 of surplus off the owner's personal return into the corporation, deferring roughly the gap between the 12.2% small-business rate and the top 53.53% personal rate until the funds were drawn.
rows.after: On one growing school we shifted $40,000 of surplus off the owner's personal return into the corporation, deferring roughly the gap between the 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) small-business rate and the top 53.53% personal rate until the funds were drawn.
rows.note: Current small-business rate in the deferral comparison; 53.53% top personal rate left unchanged.

rows.before: We incorporated the studio and moved the assets across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, capitalized the fit-out as a Class 13 leasehold improvement over the lease, and corrected worker status under RC4110.
rows.after: We incorporated the studio and moved the assets across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2%, capitalized the fit-out as a Class 13 leasehold improvement over the lease, and corrected worker status under RC4110.
